## Material submission

Please summarize what this material contains and who it is for.

### Checklist

- [ ] Files are under the intended `content/` category.
- [ ] Source files, supporting images, and lesson datasets use relative paths.
- [ ] I did not add `_site/`, `generated-live/`, `generated-pages/`, or cache files.
- [ ] The material contains no credentials or private data.
- [ ] I have permission to redistribute the material and its datasets.
- [ ] I understand that browser execution is opt-in and may require maintainer changes.
